b74170fb.text:
You dial yourself up every morning.

The switch says: what is that hum?

I’m calling for myself. The humming is not my own,

0e0bd9ea.text: but I can hear it from here, like an electric storm

e2863e16.text: that is coming toward us and is going to tear us apart.

79f01c57.text: The sky will split in two. There is a new weather pattern

e590ceb6.text: A new pattern, like when your hand falls off

ade87b84.text: at the wrist and you are left with a tiny hand. A new weather pattern

df8628b8.text: like when the water rises and the streets are full of fish

4954ee7a.text: and they're looking at me like I'm crazy.

91db150a.text: A new weather pattern like when the sun is gone

e3fe495b.text: and it is dark and I'm alone on this hill and it's warm, and

042b1f1e.text: A new weather pattern that will cut off my air.

a0e498d7.text: ‹Don't talk to me about this,› I told him. ‹It's all a game,› he said. ‹Everything's a game,›

e0feffac.text: he said, and we looked at each other, ‹you've got to win the game,› and

2626a653.text: I can't say no to him now. ‹Okay,› I say, ‹let's do it again.›

7c13a671.text: He looks down at me again. ‹How do I do that?› he says. ‹Do you want to talk about the last time you won?›

16bb9acc.text: I shake my head. ‹No,› I tell him.

d8930a91.text: He looks at me with his big eyes, and then he says,

843a89a3.text: like he has never heard of anything so trivial,›
